description:
(Summary from jobright.ai; the original posting may say more.)

Callan Family Office is hiring an early-career full-stack software engineer to help build and evolve CallanOS, the platform supporting its investment operations and client reporting. The role involves designing and shipping features across the stack, working with business teams to understand their needs, and improving data quality and software reliability.
Associate Software Engineer building full-stack platform features and resolving data issues with React, Python APIs, AWS Lambda, and PostgreSQL

Responsibilities:
• Work side by side with our engineers and leadership on the features that move the platform forward
• Help design solutions: weigh the options, propose an approach, and talk it through with the team before you build it
• Build and ship features across the full stack, from React screens to Python APIs on AWS Lambda to the PostgreSQL data behind them, that people at the firm use right away
• Sit with our operations and investment staff, listen to how they work, and turn what youhear into software that solves their problem
• Track down data problems, such as a custodian file that arrived late or a number that does not match between two systems. Find the cause and fix it so it stays fixed
• Build things to last: write tests, keep code clear, and choose designs that hold up as more firms and more data come onto the platform

Requirements:
• Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Software or Computer Engineering, or a closely related technical field
• 0–2 years of professional software engineering experience, including at least one internshipor job where code you wrote went into production
• Strong programming skills in Python or a comparable language. Given a loosely defined problem, you can write clean, working code without step-by-step guidance
• You write automated tests as a normal part of your work, both unit and integration tests,and you can explain what you chose to test and why
• A firm grasp of software development fundamentals: data structures and algorithms, clear structure across functions and modules, error handling, and code that someone else can read and change
• Working SQL, including joins, aggregations, and designing a simple schema
• You understand how a web application fits together, from the front end to the API to the database, and you have built REST APIs
• Daily use of Git, including branches, pull requests, and code review
• A passion for building and solving problems. You have built things because you wanted to, not only because a class or a job required it
• The discipline and maturity to build for scale. You care that your code is tested, readable, and will hold up as use grows
• Strong listening and critical thinking. You ask good questions, work out what a business partner actually needs, and figure out how to solve it
• Someone who wants responsibility early and is comfortable saying “I don't know yet” while working it out with the team
• Strong programming skills in Python or a comparable language
• Automated testing (unit and integration tests)
• Software development fundamentals: data structures and algorithms, clear structure across functions and modules, error handling, and maintainable code
• Working SQL, including joins, aggregations, and designing a simple schema
• Understanding of web application architecture from front end to API to database
• Experience building REST APIs
• Daily use of Git, including branches, pull requests, and code review
